scope: Literal generic raw keys only. No primary/main/component/detail/finish aliases are merged. This measures recorded descriptor labels, not an exhaustive ontology or atomic physical properties.
parsing: Use the existing Phase II product_features pipe-separated entries; partition each entry on its first colon. Match the key after Unicode NFC, casefold, trim and whitespace collapse. Keep raw entry, raw key, raw value and zero-based entry index.
normalization: Unicode NFC (not compatibility folding), casefold, trim and collapse Unicode whitespace. No spelling, synonym, morphology, punctuation, material or shade mergers.
multi_value: No native value lists or within-value delimiter are documented. Each scalar remains one complete recorded descriptor, including slashes, commas, plus signs and conjunctions. Repeated identical normalized values deduplicate; distinct duplicate-key values are conflicting/unknown, not a list of options.
none_policy: A literal color value 'none' is retained as a recorded absence-of-color descriptor; it is not mapped to clear or transparent. Material/shape 'none' does not identify a material/shape and is unknown. No mapped none values occurred in the initial census.
ambiguity: Missing keys, any missing/unknown value, malformed mapped entries, or more than one distinct normalized value exclude that product-field. A known value plus an unknown value is still unknown. Full source duplicates are retained in provenance.
audit_selection: For each field take up to 30 records with the mapped raw key present, sorted by SHA256('20261007:attribute-audit:' + field + ':' + product_id). Selection uses the complete catalog, never ranking transitions.
case_selection: Within eligible primary cancellation query-fields choose the query with smallest SHA256('20261007:case:' + query_id), separately for any eligible field with option loss and any eligible field with unchanged option set. Use material, shape, color order to choose the illustrating field. No claim of all-field completeness.
